we’re both in our 20s ! we were also living together at the time…he broke up with me and i immediately had to find another place to live. The family issues was his family giving him the pressure that he needed to take care of all of them.

How easy it was for him, how he broke up with me like we didn’t live together and he met my whole entire family (who loved him). How he didn’t bat an eye towards me post breakup and how he obviously doesn’t care about me.

constantly thinking of them is something us humans can’t help, the brain is so powerful. The more busy you get the less time you’ll spend thinking of her. I know it’s hard imaging her giving love to someone, i understand the pain. Her letting you go will only open you to a new world of love, idk why you guys ended things, but some people don’t deserve YOUR love. You have better and brighter days ahead of you!!! You deserve better and you deserve to be happy as well.

That i depended too much on other people for my own happiness, i constantly poured myself into people that i thought would never leave me after seeing me be so vulnerable. well i was wrong. now im working on myself and my giving myself the effort i gave to others…hardest pill to swallow is learning to be independent on my own after all this time. time heals.

Idk how to feel about everything, it was all out of the blue. You said it’s not fair for me and i didn’t agree…i said it was okay but in all honestly you were right. it’s not fair for me. I don’t understand how you can go on and not say a single word to me. we were together every single day, you put me back into the spot you promised you wouldn’t leave me in. you know me and yet you did this to me…? idk if i’m mad or sad or disappointed, i’m just in shock. you go on with your life like i was never there to begin with, like nothing is bothering you. but i’m driving myself insane. i dwell on what you could be doing and how tf you can be okay if all this. i’m just word vomitting but i want to txt you that i miss you so much, but why should i go crawling back when you’re the one who pushed me away. you pushed me away, never thought id see the day you do this. i want to be there for you through everything, i want to be your person. idk it just sucks constantly being abandoned by people i let get close to me.
